# ModelDock Full LLM Summary

ModelDock is an open-source control plane for self-hosted multi-user LLM apps. It combines a user chat surface, BYOK provider credential flows, user credits, budgets, admin workflows, MCP, skills, deployment templates, and LiteLLM routing into one deployable service.

## Architecture

ModelDock uses separate web, API, and admin surfaces. The API orchestrates auth, user profiles, chat metadata/content when server-stored, BYOK credential vault records, credit ledger records, and LiteLLM users/virtual keys. LiteLLM remains the provider gateway for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

## Security model

Defaults are local-only. Web, admin, and API bind to localhost in Docker Compose. Postgres and LiteLLM are internal-only. Admin must be deployed on a separate protected hostname in production. Provider keys and OAuth tokens must be encrypted at rest and never logged. LiteLLM master keys are server-only.

## Provider strategy

Official support is API-key and OpenAI-compatible provider access through LiteLLM. Subscription OAuth adapters are experimental, disabled by default, per-user only, and never positioned as a way to bypass provider billing or terms.

## Current limitations

The repository is in early development. Public docs describe the current scaffold, shipped package boundaries, and stable security constraints.
